title: Fleet tier of the post-link stage cache
description: ☁️ A post-link stage (describe, transpile, optimize, probe) is a pure function of the digests of its inputs, the identities of its tools and its own schema version. Its outputs are computed once in the fleet: a machine whose local stage cache misses looks the stage up at the fleet cache (key = SHA-256 of the namespace, the machine's platform and the stage key digest), claims it when nobody has it, computes, stores the files by their digests and the entry as a Bazel action result whose first file is the stage manifest, and releases the claim; a machine that finds the claim held waits for the upload instead of computing. Every entry belongs to a slot (the stage and the module it builds without its content inputs), so a newer entry of a slot supersedes the older ones, at the fleet cache and in the local stage cache. A cache that is down, denies, stalls or serves a corrupt entry never fails or hangs a stage: it is computed here.
